title: synthetic-data-generator
summary: A Python synthesis engine that generates synthetic tabular data using multiple generative model backends selectable by the caller. It wraps SDV's single-table synthesizers (CTGAN, TVAE, CopulaGAN, GaussianCopula) via SDV's metadata schema to fit and sample synthetic datasets.
